questions.stem: A man spends \(80\%\) of his income. If his income is Rs. \(20,000\), how much does he save?
A man gives \(10\%\) of his salary to his wife and \(20\%\) of the remainder to his son. If he is left with Rs. \(7,200\), what was his salary?
questions.keySolution:
Let salary = \(x\)
Amount after wife = \(0.9x\)
Amount after son = \(0.8 \times 0.9x = 0.72x\)
Given \(0.72x = 7,200\) ⇒ \(x = 10,000\)

questions.stem: If A's salary is \(20\%\) more than B's salary, by what percent is B's salary less than A's?
A person spends \(30\%\) of his income on rent, \(20\%\) on food, and \(10\%\) on transport. If his income is Rs. \(10,000\), how much does he save?
A man’s salary is increased by \(10\%\) and then decreased by \(10\%\). What is the net change in salary?
Passing marks in an exam are \(40\%\). A student scores \(180\) and fails by \(20\) marks. What are the maximum marks?
A person spends \(75\%\) of his income. If his income rises by \(20\%\) and expenditure by \(10\%\), what is the percentage rise in savings?
questions.keySolution:
Assume income = \(100\): expenditure = \(75\), savings = \(25\)
New income = \(120\); new exp. = \(82.5\)
New savings = \(37.5\)
Increase = \(12.5\) on \(25\) = \(50\%\)
